title: Close-enough general routing problem for multiple unmanned aerial vehicles in monitoring missions
summary: In this paper, we introduce a close-enough multi-UAV general routing problem (CEMUAVGRP) where a fleet of homogeneous UAVs conduct monitoring tasks containing nodes, each of which has its disk neighborhood, and edges, aiming to minimize the total distance.
